cards.title: AICA in six swipes. Let's go.
cards.body: AICA is a healthcare app being built in Lucknow. It links patients, chemists and doctors on one shared prescription thread, so nothing gets lost in between.

cards.title: Scan the prescription
cards.body: Take a photo of the paper. AI reads it, and you check it against the photo before anything is saved. No blind trust.

cards.title: Reminders that get Indian prescriptions
cards.body: Dose reminders understand 1-0-1 and half tablets. Family profiles let you manage Mummy and Papa from one phone, with vitals and a care diary alongside.

cards.title: Chemists get a smarter counter
cards.body: Pharmacies get AI help reading handwriting, plus refill predictions that bring patients back to the same counter they trust.

cards.title: Doctors walk in prepared
cards.body: Clinics get a patient summary before the visit, so the consult starts with context instead of a hunt through old papers.

cards.title: Early days, and you can join
cards.body: AICA is at MVP stage, with an interactive prototype and waitlist at aicaglobal.in. Pilots are starting in Lucknow. The core patient app is free forever.

takeaway: AICA links patients, chemists and doctors on one prescription thread, with checked AI scans, smart reminders and an open waitlist.
